metin.SexyKO'da bulunan **Daily Quest Sistemi*: With the **Daily Quest System** in SexyKO, you can follow your daily quests in a single window, activate them and complete them before time runs out to receive your rewards automatically.
metin.DAILY QUEST PENCERESİNE NASIL ULAŞILIR?: HOW TO OPEN THE DAILY QUEST WINDOW?
metin.Oyun ekranının **sol alt kısmında buluna: Click the **marked area at the bottom left of the game screen** to open the Daily Quest window.
metin.Bu pencere üzerinden mevcut günlük görev: In this window you can see the current daily quests and check which ones are active.
metin.Görev listesindeki **Detail** seçeneğine: Click the **Detail** option in the quest list to open the quest window.
metin.Bu bölümde görevin:: In this section you can see the quest's:
metin.GÖREV NASIL AKTİF EDİLİR?: HOW DO YOU ACTIVATE A QUEST?
metin.**2️⃣** İlgili görevin **Detail** bölümü: **2️⃣** Go to the **Detail** section of the quest.
metin.Bu noktadan sonra görevi belirtilen süre: From this point on, you need to complete the quest within the given time.
metin.**Accept** butonuna bastığınız anda göre: The quest timer starts the moment you press **Accept**.
metin.Görevi süre dolmadan tamamlamanız gereki: You need to complete the quest before time runs out.
metin.Süre içerisinde gerekli şartları tamamla: When you meet the requirements within the time, the system tracks your progress automatically.
metin.ÖDÜL NASIL ALINIR?: HOW DO YOU GET THE REWARD?
metin.Görevi başarıyla tamamladığınızda ödülün: When you complete the quest successfully, you don't need to go to an NPC to collect your reward.
metin.**Görev tamamlandığında ödülünüz otomati: **When the quest is completed, your reward is credited to your account / character automatically.**
metin.Bu sayede görev süreci tamamen oyun için: This way the whole quest process is done quickly, entirely in game.
metin.**Sol alttaki Daily Quest ikonuna tıkla: **Click the Daily Quest icon at the bottom left → pick your quest → open Detail → press Accept → complete it before time runs out → get your reward automatically**
metin.Görevini seç • Süreni başlat • Tamamla •: Pick your quest • Start the timer • Complete it • Take your reward!
